title: Release promotion and GHCR publication
intent: After a normal pull request merges to main, maintain a Release Please release PR. When that release PR merges, create the semantic tag and GitHub release, then dispatch the tagged image workflow so active CPU and Apple images are built, smoke-tested, and published to GHCR. Keep NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel paths inactive. Update the README Decapod badge to v0.96.15.
proof_hooks: yq eval "." .github/workflows/release-please.yml .github/workflows/release-images.yml; GOCACHE=/tmp/kaite-gocache go test ./...; GOCACHE=/tmp/kaite-gocache go vet ./...; decapod validate --refresh-specs
